question: What Are the Types of Bourdon Tube Pressure Gauge?
body_html:
Bourdon tube pressure gauge types are named after the shape of the curved, hollow metal tube that tries to straighten when pressure enters it and moves the pointer through a link, sector gear and pinion.

TypeTube shapeBest use
C typeC shaped tubeLow to medium pressure, most common
Spiral typeSpiral coilLow pressure where fine accuracy is needed
Helical typeHelix, like a springVery high pressure, resists overpressure
